title: Test: concurrent TAKETHIS flood does not exceed queue capacity
description:
Ingestion queue depth counter uses Relaxed atomics with a non-synchronized snapshot (o0r.3). No test exercises the queue under concurrent load to confirm the depth never exceeds capacity.

Write a test in crates/transit/tests/ that:
1. Starts a transit ingestion pipeline with queue capacity C (e.g., 128)
2. Spawns N concurrent tasks (N >> C, e.g., 1024) each sending a distinct valid TAKETHIS article
3. Asserts that at no point does the live queue depth exceed C
4. Asserts that all articles eventually either succeed (200) or are rejected with 431 (queue full) — no silent drops

Implementation note: expose a queue_depth() accessor on IngestionQueue for test introspection, or check via metrics. The race in o0r.3 is between is_full() read and the actual enqueue; the test should run with TOKIO_TEST_THREADS=1 and multi-threaded to catch both the single-threaded scheduling case and the real concurrent case.
